title: Node
description: Node describes a single node of the underlying LXD cluster AMS manages

address.description: Internal IP address of the node

cpu_allocation_rate.description: CPU allocation rate for the node

cpus.description: Number of CPUs on the node

gpu_encoder_slots.description: Number of GPU encoder slots present on the node

gpu_slots.description: Number of GPU slots present on the node

is_master.description: Flag to represent the master node for the AMS cluster

managed.description: Flag used to control if AMS can manage the LXD node

memory.description: Memory (in GB) of the LXD node

memory_allocation_rate.description: Memory allocation rate for the node

network_bridge_mtu.description: MTU for the configured network bridge on LXD

public_address.description: Public IP address of the node

storage_pool.description: Name of the storage pool configured for the node

unscheduable.description: DEPRECATED Flag in favour of `unschedulable` flag

unschedulable.description: Flag used to see if the node is available to schedule containers

NodeGPU.description: NodeGPU describes a single GPU available on a node

allocations.description: Map of current allocations and containers on the GPU

encoder_slots.description: Number of the encoder slots available on the GPU

id.description: ID of the GPU configured on the node

numa_node.description: NUMA Node number for the GPU

pci_address.description: PCI Bus Address used by the GPU

render_name.description: PCI Bus Address used by the GPU

slots.description: Number of the GPU slots available

NodeGPUAllocation.description: NodeGPUAllocation describes a single allocation on a GPU

encoder_slots.description: Number of Encoder Slots allocated to the container

gpus.description: List of GPU IDs allocated to the container

slots.description: Number of GPU Slots allocated to the container

NodeStatus.description: NodeStatus describes the current status of a node

NodeVPU.description: NodeVPU describes a single independent VPU available on a node

allocations.description: Map of current allocations on the VPU

numa_node.description: NUMA node the card sits on

slots.description: Number of slots available on the VPU

type.description: Type of the VPU. Valid values are: unknown, netint

NodeVPUAllocation.description: NodeVPUAllocation describes a single allocation for a VPU

ids.description: VPU IDs the allocation is for

slots.description: Number of slots used by this allocation
